question:

FJM : UQN

DPQ : WKJ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

FJM : UQN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9613c918af0974bcf83c75d52a9cf7b1f374defcf226eea38f21c2ab4372087.png] 

And,

DPQ : WKJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cb39b9fc160008b8e5bdf0c01f6cd3f75be6571a7dd5dab86d29c8b79ba52db.png]

Option 1) IEB : ACK

Option 3) LHE : VUT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c44f03aaf7c941274a0d6476cc7b73388671289c583b2d1fb42479fb4d4a2549.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf54deb6c6344148756dbabd8b447a973140c95fc86f48677c0bd2277cee00bb.png]
